newsitem.title: UK: Abbey up after report of imminent "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: Abbey up after report of imminent "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc jumped in early trade on Wednesday as a report in the Financial Times said an unnamed brokerage believed recent declines in the stock had gone far enough and was poised to issue a "buy" note.
The stock, which has retreated in recent sessions from its record close of 800-1/2p set on January 14, was up 13-1/2p at 757 by 0830 GMT.

Panmure Gordon analyst David Poutney said he had reaffirmed his "strong buy" rating on Abbey, arguing that it was trading at a small discount to the rest of the banking sector and had come back nearly 10 percent from its highs.
He said the housing market was improving and demand for consumer credit was strong, while there was a strong chance of a special dividend or share buyback alongside results due on February 27.
